candidates.name: Coalinga and Pyramid Hills SkyTEM312, 2022
candidates.declared_processing_level: raw, fully processed AEM, and inverted resistivity

staged_protocol.stage_1: Inspect only official inventories, NCML, FGDC XML, reports, and flightline geometry.
staged_protocol.stage_2_condition: Before any response payload access, metadata must prove coordinates, line identity, transmitter geometry and current, exact waveform, gate times, response components, and per-observation uncertainty semantics.
staged_protocol.stage_2_role_rule: Freeze a coordinate-first spatial split and verify a correlation-adjusted upper bound of at least 223 effective test clusters before opening response arrays.
staged_protocol.abort_condition: Do not access response payloads when the metadata contract fails or the response-blind spatial design cannot possibly provide 223 effective test clusters.
